name: 主体内离焦约束 / 主体清晰保护 V2
purpose: Fixed diagnostic strategy, not depth correction or Ours. Q1 subject defocus distribution vs existing local detail observations; Q2 one tau across exploration sources and normal controls.

samples.role: highest eligible input-statistic rank4; no output inspected before selection

rule: Each frame on ORIGINAL grid, d=q/255 float64; inside original DAVIS ID!=0 union clamp d to[focus-tau/K,focus+tau/K], outside unchanged. Convert resulting q-scale float to native FP32 and use exact original author abs->bilinear antialias Resize->CenterCrop->Normalize. No PNG re-quantization. Transplant CoC only. Original MPI remains from original q.
failure_policy: Apply all25 frames, no per-frame skip, area limit, morphology, smoothing or hysteresis; no tau search or case-specific choice. Invalid input stops with evidence. Tiny FP32 deviations around exact mathematical cap are reported, not hidden by retuning.
mask_permission: DAVIS GT target union now supplies per-pixel CoC constraints beyond its baseline role in computing focus scalar. Generator does not receive mask/alpha directly. Not predicted-mask deployment.
multi_instance: Use entire union without choosing an easier ID. Per-ID statistics and outputs separate; may flatten genuine subject/object depth. Train4IDs and stroller2IDs disclosed.
execution: Original author f7a16959, original FP16/native VAE FP32 upcast; load seed0; restore legacy saved scene-entry CPU/CUDA state, CPU generator0 per call; original8-frame windows/4overlap/8-8-9 outputs, padding and caches. Independent clean process per scene/condition. CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, serial GPU.
RNG_metadata_scope: Restore existing scene-boundary RNG metadata only, even when preceding legacy scene belongs to held-out split; never inspect that video's inputs, predictions or metrics.
A_policy: First rerun full25 B18 A and compare all RGB8 bytes to frozen DAVIS PNGs (legacy has no float arrays). Equal: others reuse frozen A; B18 probe reused, B36 current paired A reused. Unequal: all6 have current-environment A, reusing B18 probe and already-current B36 A as explicitly authorized, rerunning other4; preserve/report legacy mismatch. No unnecessary B36 rerun.
region_policy: Freeze masks BEFORE predictions: for each original nonzero ID AND independent union, nearest native limited-pixel mask intersect nearest ID display mask; remainder=ID minus limited. Exterior ring distance>=2 and<=6 display pixels from each ID/union, exclude ALL union foreground. Far background=distance>32 from UNION, same support shared across IDs (not independent repetitions). Euclidean precise distance; no intervention morphology. All A/V2 share exactly the same masks. B36 adds existing R2 input-defined target_head mask, held common for A/R2/V2, separate from full subject.
metrics: RGB8 MAE vs cv2.INTER_LINEAR projected original RGB (same prior CPU diagnostic convention), full-image Sobel3x3 energy ratio on3x3-eroded support. RGB8 V2-A mean/max channel difference, counts; ring/background peak coordinates ties row-major. Float comparisons only if a real current A float exists; no PNG/255 surrogate float. Empty support null. Adjacent frame differences use pair mask union, no motion compensation: region change, not flicker.
B36_R2_comparison: On common input-defined R2 head target, report A/R2/V2 MAE and edge ratio each frame; descriptive gap-fill fractions=(MAE_A-MAE_V2)/(MAE_A-MAE_R2) and(edge_V2-edge_A)/(edge_R2-edge_A), null if abs denominator<=1e-12, never clipped. These are input-relative numeric gaps, not recovered perceptual quality percentages.
stop: 统计与配对推理完成，等待用户视觉复核。Only six exploration sources; no held-out, training, PPT/talk/formal-table edits.
